name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-postgres-inventory
description: A real second InventoryAdapter implementation (ims-postgres-alternate epic), backed by Postgres -- proves subsystem 11's own doc comment true ("an external-IMS adapter is the same interface with a different implementation proxying to a real system") with a genuine second backend, not just the one in-memory default @mercatus-liber/inventory ships. Public surface is exactly InventoryAdapter -- no pg-specific type leaks out. Reuses the exact same DATABASE_URL/pg.Pool infrastructure @mercatus-liber/adapter-postgres already proved out for catalog persistence, so this needs no new external account beyond whatever Postgres/Supabase connection a deployment already has. Depends on @mercatus-liber/core (StockLevel/InventoryAdapter live in @mercatus-liber/inventory, referenced structurally) and @mercatus-liber/inventory for the interface it implements.
